book_vs_repo_gap: This chapter captures the main embedding lesson in NumPy, but it still lacks GloVe, analogy suites, and broader corpus-scale intrinsic evaluation.

chapter_notes.counterintuitive_insight: Embedding quality is more about neighborhood stability under small corpus shifts than about a single pretty nearest-neighbor screenshot.
covered_claims: PPMI and SGNS-style embeddings can coexist in one NumPy-only chapter.
Isotropy and neighbor stability are useful intrinsic diagnostics.

failure_modes.note: Neighborhoods shift under a one-sentence corpus perturbation.

failure_modes.example: speech and language may look close because they share contexts.

lesson_objectives: Construct embeddings from cooccurrence statistics and predictive training.
Evaluate geometry through isotropy and neighborhood stability.
